notes.title: A (not so) mysterious code unleashes an hidden tune, start your search!
notes.content:
There's a little something hidden in the game, a special track that Joe Dever himself recorded to share some ancient verses.

In order to listen to it, you'll have to use a certain code that has been proven to work in dozens of games, a code almost mythical, a code that blossomed in the far east, and travelled all the globe sailing on the digital waves of the gaming industry.

You know what we're talking about, don't you?

Very well, use that code, start your search and find what's hidden!

For Sommerlund and the Kai!

notes.title: Check out the video that started it all!
notes.content:
Hi there,

today we are sharing with you something very valuable for us, the intro video of Joe Dever's Lone Wolf.

We've seen this 1-minute intro dozens of times, and each one we are excited like the first.

It may be the epic background music, the inspired art style, or the voice of Joe Dever himself, what counts is that we are loving it, and we hope that you feel the same!

Thank you for playing the game, and thanks for sharing your feedback here on this community, on our [url=http://lonewolfthegame.com/blog/] devblog[/url] and on [url=https://www.facebook.com/lonewolfthegame] Facebook[/url]!

http://youtu.be/B_tx5AMj5O4

notes.title: Don't miss the bonus content, our epic soundtrack and the digital artbook are right there!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We would like to know your feedback on the bonus content included in the HD Remastered edition of Joe Dever's Lone Wolf.

With the Steam edition we wanted to give you something special, and so we decided to include the original soundtrack and a digital artbook!

To check the bonus content you'll need to follow this path: {Your Steam Library}\SteamApps\common\Joe Dever’s Lone Wolf\Extras

We are loving the music and the art style, you? :)

notes.title: We are live, the HD Remastered edition is available!
notes.content:
We are excited that Joe Dever's Lone Wolf HD Remastered is finally available for Mac and PC.

This is an amazing moment for us, the response to the announcement of the Steam version was huge by Lone Wolf fans, and we are humbled by your passion. 

We hope that this HD Remastered edition will entertain you as much as we enjoyed developing it!

notes.title: Lone Wolf is on Steam, hi everybody!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Alessandro from Forge Reply here.

We are really excited to launch our official community here on Steam, as the release date of the HD Remastered edition is closing in!

You'll be able to enjoy the game in less than a week, over on our Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/lonewolfthegame) we are killing time with a nice social reading experience, sharing the original Lone Wolf gamebooks!

We really cannot wait to know your feedback on the Steam version!

For Sommerlund and the Kai!
